fixed_stress.scope: Identical preregistered descriptive stress projections for every arm/seed. No TEST threshold, risk, arm, or seed winner selection.

definitions.admission: Full clock, causal feature_available and predicted side marginal only. Future y/maturity/execution completeness never gates an attempt.
definitions.teacher_buckets: Attach y only after actual one-position replay: NONE, wrong side of known positive event, target-positive chosen side (includes BOTH), or UNKNOWN. Count completed filled trades separately from empty/censored attempts.
definitions.positive_teacher: Geometric crossing label is not executed profitability: STOP may precede a qualifying crossing and latency/costs change realized cash.
definitions.cash: USD per reference ounce under saved taker BBO execution. CENSORED halts the entire path; observed_closed_cash is a partial prefix and total_net_if_complete=null.
definitions.drawdown: Closed-trade drawdown only; not intratrade mark-to-market or position sizing simulation.
definitions.pending: EMPTY blocks until intent+2s inclusive; COMPLETE blocks through exit timestamp inclusive; account state persists across dates.
definitions.small_buckets: All bucket counts and observed money are shown. Empty buckets have null means/rates. No significance or economic readiness is inferred from sparse buckets.
